# cork-search-form

A simple search form with optional facet buttons. Can be added as a child of the [`cork-header`](../elements/cork-header.md) element, or of a [`cork-search-tray`](../elements/cork-search-tray.md).

On submit:

- With formAction set, the form submits natively. Otherwise it fires a cork-search event for the app to handle.
- The search button submits as submitParam=Submit, and a facet button as its name=value, so the request says which one was used.
- After a search, it asks a parent cork-header to close its nav tray, unless keepTrayOpen is set.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | The search text. Cleared when the header's nav tray hides the form. |
| `placeholder` | `String` | The input's placeholder. Default: 'Search...'. Attribute: placeholder. |
| `formAction` | `String` | URL to submit the form to. If unset, the form fires a cork-search event instead. Attribute: form-action. |
| `formMethod` | `String` | HTTP method for a native submit. Default: 'POST'. Attribute: form-method. |
| `labelText` | `String` | Visually hidden label for the input. Default: 'Search'. Attribute: label-text. |
| `queryParam` | `String` | Name of the input, i.e. the search text's key in the request. Default: 'searchterm'. Attribute: query-param. |
| `submitParam` | `String` | Name of the search button, i.e. its key in the request. Default: 'search'. Attribute: submit-param. |
| `submitAriaLabel` | `String` | Accessible name of the search button, which shows an icon. Default: 'Search'. Attribute: submit-aria-label. |
| `clearOnSearch` | `Boolean` | Clears the input after a cork-search event. Attribute: clear-on-search. |
| `keepTrayOpen` | `Boolean` | Keeps the cork-header's nav tray open after a search. Attribute: keep-tray-open. |
| `categoryBrand` | `String` | A campus category brand name, e.g. 'admin-blue', for the form's background color. Attribute: category-brand. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Facet buttons: button elements, direct children only. Not an actual slot, but rather parsed and rendered into the shadow DOM as submit buttons.<br><br>• name: required. Its key in the request.<br>• value: defaults to its text.<br>• aria-label: copied over. |

## Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-search` | Fired on submit when formAction isn't set.<br><br>• detail.query: the search text.<br>• detail.facet: the facet button's name, or the submitParam for the search button and the Enter key. |
| `cork-nav-tray-close-request` | Fired after cork-search, unless keepTrayOpen is set. cork-header closes its nav tray. |

## Methods

### static get shadowRootOptions

Lit shadow root options. delegatesFocus forwards focus() on the element to its first focusable control,
e.g. when cork-header opens its nav tray.

### onNavTrayHide()

Called by cork-header (directly, or through cork-search-tray) when its nav tray hides this element. Clears the input.

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-search-form';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkSearchForm from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-search-form/cork-search-form.js';
```

**Listen for search events**

```html
<cork-search-form placeholder="Search the library" @cork-search=${e => this._search(e.detail)}></cork-search-form>
```

**Submit a search natively**

```html
<cork-search-form form-action="/search" form-method="get"></cork-search-form>
```

**With facet buttons**

```html
<cork-search-form placeholder="Search Library Materials">
  <button name="books">Books</button>
  <button name="articles">Articles</button>
</cork-search-form>
```
